chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.summary: Magnus discovers rare magical ability in childhood, learns that deeper understanding increases control, reads the book The Paths of Magic, and resolves to master every path.

chapters.title: Land of Water
chapters.summary: Magnus studies tides, currents and a dangerous whirlpool, reaches an underwater essence crystal, and gains deep control over water.

chapters.title: Land of Trees
chapters.summary: Magnus enters a living forest, reaches an ancient tree and green essence shard, and learns the interconnected ecological nature of tree magic.

chapters.title: Land of Earth
chapters.summary: Magnus crosses rocky canyons, evades earth golems, reaches an earth essence stone, and learns the slow geological forces shaping the world.

chapters.title: Land of Sun
chapters.summary: Magnus crosses bright grasslands, survives a gryphon attack, reaches a refracting sun stone, and learns to manipulate light and solar energy.

chapters.title: Land of Wind
chapters.summary: Magnus climbs into high mountains, overcomes harpies and wind furies, reaches twin peaks, and learns the fluid dynamics and pressure behavior of air.

chapters.title: Land of Fire
chapters.summary: Magnus ascends an active volcano, battles fire creatures and a Fire Avatar, reaches the fire essence, and learns combustion and the storage of magical energy in gemstones.

chapters.title: Land of Lightning
chapters.summary: Magnus enters a perpetual storm, confronts magnetic golems and lightning furies, reaches Tximistarri in the storm's eye, and masters lightning and electricity.

chapters.title: Mage Tower
chapters.summary: Magnus discovers the abandoned Mage Tower, studies ancient knowledge, defeats a sealed Lich King, enchants the Longsword of the Lifeforce of Elysia, crosses a portal to Azeroth, defeats the Enderdragon, and becomes master of the tower.
